issue.title: Cabinets runner captures leak panel state and miss the album card head; fixtures are not live-shaped

task_type_fields.impact: Acceptance reviewers can pass captures that do not show the claimed state, such as closed content cabinets in Live Preview and the Records head, so regressions there would slip through review.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins scripts/obsidian-cabinets-e2e.cjs (rest captures, album shots) and scripts/obsidian-cabinets-e2e-lib.cjs (fixtures)
task_type_fields.repro:
Three fidelity gaps in bob-plugins `scripts/obsidian-cabinets-e2e.cjs` and
`scripts/obsidian-cabinets-e2e-lib.cjs` mean some captures do not show what they claim
to show.

1. **Panel state leaks between captures** (bob-cli-qq.10.5 note #2). Cabinet open state
   is session-shared, so the Live Preview "at rest" area shots still have Notebooks and
   Albums open from earlier runner steps. Only the Reading shots show the four closed
   content cabinets. Fix: call `resetPanels` (or equivalent) before every `rest`
   capture.
2. **Fixtures are not live-shaped** (bob-cli-qq.10.4 note #2). The fixture separates
   catalogs with two blank lines, and absorption consumes only one, so Live Preview
   shows a gap the live vault never has. It also uses a bare `> [!records]` head, which
   bob's index writer never emits (see the Records · Records task).
3. **The album card head is never in frame** (bob-cli-qq.10.4 note #2). Every album
   screenshot scrolls past the card head, so the Records cabinet header and its summary
   are never visually reviewed. Add an album capture scrolled to the card head.

Repro: run the runner per bob-plugins `docs/develop/validation.md` ("Real-Obsidian
Cabinets acceptance") on athena. Then inspect the area `*-live-*-rest` and album
captures in the retained switch-on bundle file:explicit:b43b18736a494f39c0fdc3fc.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-qq.10.4 (note #2) and bob-cli-qq.10.5 (note #2) and triaged together by the bob-cli-qq.10 land agent: both are cabinets-runner capture-fidelity gaps found during acceptance and smoke review, left open after GO.

payload.entry: RELATED: bob-cli-rj (the bare [!records] fixture head is the Records · Records case; fix the fixture and the summary together or in order).
